home.title: Rescue simulation for RoboCupJunior
home.description: Program a robot to explore a maze, identify wall tokens and map the environment. The simulation platform of RoboCupJunior Rescue.
home.hero.title: Send your robot
home.hero.lead: No remote control. Just your code against an unknown world: explore it, find everyone in it, and bring back the map.
home.mission.title: Three jobs. Eight minutes.
home.explore.title: Explore
home.explore.text: An unknown maze, with no remote control. Your program has to read its sensors, find a way through swamps, holes, obstacles and curved walls, and stop on a contact tile before the battery runs out.
home.explore.alt: The robot driving through a blue passage in the maze
home.identify.title: Identify
home.identify.text: Victims and cognitive targets wait on the walls, and fakes are hiding among them. Read the faces, add up the rings and report only what is real.
home.identify.alt: The robot in front of a cognitive target, with smiley victims on the walls
home.map.title: Map
home.map.text: Turn everything the robot saw into a matrix of walls, floors and tokens. A perfect map multiplies your whole score by 2.2.
home.tools.title: Build the robot. Build the world.
home.tools.robot.title: Robot Customizer
home.tools.robot.text: Choose your sensors and wheels, place them, and stay within the budget.
home.tools.world.title: World Editor
home.tools.world.text: Draw your own mazes, and export them to Erebus to train your robot.
home.tools.community.title: Community
home.tools.community.text: Ask questions and meet the teams from around the world on Discord.
home.start.title: Your robot is waiting.
home.start.install.title: Install
home.start.rules.title: Learn the game
home.start.rules.text: The mission, the field and the scoring.
home.start.robot.title: Get your robot
home.start.robot.text: Build the starter robot, or download it.
home.start.program.title: Program it
home.start.program.text: From your first program to the whole game.
